plan.title: Browser e2e spec (linked-conversation-title-bar) runs in the default unit shards and timed out on main; move heavy e2e out of the default run
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4733 (follow-up: gating browser lane, other specs, un-quarantine)

narratives.Problem: main CI is red since the PAN-4650 merge (run 41335061342, commit 8d26b6fb84f): tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts starts a Vite dev server and Chromium inside the CI unit shards (vitest.config.ts includes tests/**/*.spec.ts) and its warm-up page.goto times out at 180 s. A CI re-run failed identically, so the failure is deterministic and every PR that merges main inherits it.
narratives.Proposal: Minimal fix requested by the operator. (1) Add the spec to scripts/flaky-quarantine.txt with a PAN-4733 reference: vitest.config.ts (readQuarantineList) then excludes it from the CI shards and the verification gate, and the non-blocking flake-lane job, which installs Chromium, keeps running it in CI. (2) Add a five-state case to ConversationMachineBanner.test.tsx, already in the CI frontend subset, asserting chip, banner, buttons and read-only notice for local, remote, offline-saved, offline-none and released. The gating browser lane, the audit of the other tests/e2e specs, the root cause and the un-quarantine are follow-up PAN-4733.
narratives.NonGoals:
- No change to vitest.config.ts, .github/workflows/ci.yml or scripts/run-flake-lane.sh
- No change to the browser spec tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts or its fixture tests/e2e/fixtures/linked-conversations.ts
- No move, rename or quarantine of tests/e2e/issue-tree.spec.ts, merge-train.spec.ts or styleguide-conformance.spec.ts (PAN-4733)
- No root-cause fix for the warm-up timeout and no un-quarantine (PAN-4733)
- No ten-consecutive-CI-runs proof (PAN-4733)
- No colour or screenshot assertions in the component test
- No edit to scripts/frontend-test-subset.txt
- No .skip, .only or skipIf added to any test
- No docs edit
- No test of ComposerFooter's read-only switch (the component test checks MachineReadOnlyNotice as the browser fixture renders it)

metadata.docsJustification: The change adds one entry to scripts/flaky-quarantine.txt (whose header documents the quarantine and flake lane) and one test case; no documented behaviour, command or configuration changes. Documentation for the browser lane is part of follow-up PAN-4733.

autoDecisions.summary: Use the CI quarantine list, not the slow-test convention, to take the spec out of the shards.
autoDecisions.rationale: The operator offered both. The spec fails deterministically on main, so a gating slow-test lane in test-e2e would keep the required test check red; the quarantine keeps it running in the existing non-blocking flake lane, which installs Chromium.

autoDecisions.summary: Reference follow-up PAN-4733 in the quarantine entry.
autoDecisions.rationale: lint-quarantine-audit.sh requires an issue reference, and PAN-4732 closes when this lands; PAN-4733 owns the root cause and the un-quarantine.

autoDecisions.summary: Define the five component-test rows inline instead of sharing a module with the browser fixture.
autoDecisions.rationale: Sharing would edit the quarantined spec and fixture, growing the fast fix; a frontend test cannot import the tests/e2e fixture without a second copy of React.

autoDecisions.summary: Move the issue's 10-consecutive-CI-runs criterion and the audit of the other tests/e2e specs to PAN-4733.
autoDecisions.rationale: Operator direction: keep this plan minimal. Ten green runs only mean something in the gating lane PAN-4733 builds.

In src/dashboard/frontend/src/components/chat/__tests__/ConversationMachineBanner.test.tsx add RemoteHeaderActions to the '../ConversationMachineBanner' import; keep the existing vi.mock lines, helpers and tests. At the end of the file add, with a comment naming both sources: STATES = ['local','remote','offline-saved','offline-none','released']; BASE, LINKED, a rowFor(state) switch and CONTINUATION copied verbatim from tests/e2e/fixtures/linked-conversations.ts (lines 27-55, conversationFor and CONTINUATION); and the EXPECTED table copied verbatim from tests/e2e/linked-conversation-title-bar.spec.ts (lines 43-50). composer
for local/remote or otherwise. Assert against EXPECTED[state]: machine-chip texts equal [chip] or []; first machine-banner text contains banner, or no banner when null; trimmed non-empty button texts equal buttons; machine-read-only-notice count equals readOnly ? 1 : 0. No fetch stub is needed (OpenPreviewPopover queries only when open); if happy-dom reports an unexpected request, stub globalThis.fetch inside the describe and restore it in afterEach.
